continuous_hand_yaw.limitation: Selected frames confirm the seam and stable silhouette; initial low frame rate does not establish frame-perfect coverage for every camera setting.

reported_rock_collision.scope: Specific RockFinal surface in PEAK Level_85, approached from the Minecraft stair used to reproduce the report. This is not a guarantee for every map or surface.

solver_regression.original_failure: Cyclic reordering of the same synthetic triangle vertices could reverse the horizontal push direction.
solver_regression.correction: Choose the wall side from a point on the same triangle plane at the previous body-centre height.

gameplay_observations.before: The Minecraft body passed through the reported rock and fell approximately eight metres; native PEAK remained on its surface.
gameplay_observations.after_first_retest: The Minecraft body slid outward and down from the stair instead of falling through the rock. Health remained at 100 percent and the settled position stayed stable.
gameplay_observations.first_retest_limitation: Camera heading changed during the first retest; a repeat with pinned heading was requested.
gameplay_observations.controlled_heading_repeat: Repeated ordinary forward input with the camera heading pinned at the equivalent of 180 degrees and pitch 15 degrees. The body moved outward/down and settled outside RockFinal instead of falling through it.
gameplay_observations.native_climb_followup: The native V climb accepted the real rock surface, retained native control after the grab ended and returned to Minecraft after a settled native landing.

reported_rock_collision.privacy: This summary contains only measurements and test results. It contains no raw geometry, proprietary source, account identifiers or private paths.

native_backpack_wheel.confirmation: After releasing G, native pocket 4 contained Backpack and the beach world bag disappeared.

final_native_impulse_retention_runtime.interpretation: Native poison and incapacitation remain separate from shared Injury/health and hunger.

native_jumps_and_amulet.implementation: Retains original native jump/super-jump and CollisionModifier forces through native landing. Original costs/events/forces are not replaced.
native_jumps_and_amulet.blue_effect_in_reported_video: Not classified as a passive double jump without confirming the actual item and action.
